aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Drawn to a haunting apartment that resurrects her darkest childhood memories, Malee forms an unexpected bond with a enigmatic tea master while confronting the ghosts of her past.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Malee, a young woman burdened by a troubled history, finds herself irresistibly pulled to a mysterious apartment linked to her childhood. There, she meets Pran, a skilled botanist and floral tea master who brings a quiet complexity to her surroundings. As eerie supernatural forces and repressed traumas resurface, Malee must navigate the thin line between healing and horror. Together, their unfolding relationship becomes both a sanctuary and a catalyst for uncovering lingering secrets.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Malee is a young woman constantly shadowed by lingering traumas and dark memories from her upbringing. Fate intervenes when she is inexplicably drawn to a specific apartment building, a location deeply intertwined with the painful past she has spent years trying to escape. Upon moving into the space, she finds that the walls seem to hold haunting secrets that trigger intense psychological and supernatural manifestations. Amidst this distress, she crosses paths with Pran, a mild-mannered botanist and tea blending master who has built a successful Thai floral tea brand. Pran offers a calming presence, introducing Malee to the delicate art of botanical blending as a form of sensory solace. However, as their connection deepens into an unexpected romance, the chilling phenomena within the apartment grow increasingly volatile. malee begins to realize that her meeting with Pran may not be entirely accidental, and the history of the apartment is directly linked to her own suppressed memories. As horrific visions push her to the brink of sanity, Malee must face the dark truth behind the stain on her past before it consumes them both. Ultimately, she is forced to decide whether embracing the uncomfortable reality of her history is the only way to break the haunting cycle.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: The Stain is a genre-blending narrative that fuses atmospheric horror and psychological thriller elements with a tender, dramatic romance. The story follows Malee, a woman attempting to outrun a deeply troubled childhood, whose life takes a mysterious turn when fate guides her to a specific apartment complex. As chilling, unexplainable encounters force her to relive her suppressed history, she meets Pran—a dedicated botanist, master tea blender, and founder of an artisanal Thai floral tea brand. Pran’s serene world of botanicals provides Malee with a temporary safe haven, leading to an intriguing romantic bond between the two. Yet, as the eerie forces inside the apartment escalate, the boundary between sensory healing and lingering nightmare blurs. Malee is pushed to confront the dark truths buried in her memories, embarking on a suspenseful journey through grief, trauma, and redemption.

story_structure.climax: A pivotal confrontation forces Malee to face the central source of her childhood memories directly within the apartment, putting her emotional resilience and her relationship with Pran to the ultimate test.
story_structure.conflict: As Malee interacts with Pran, the peaceful sanctuary of his floral world sharply contrasts with the hidden trauma resurfacing in her memory. She faces an internal struggle between maintaining her current guard and confronting the deep-seated emotional pain anchored to the apartment.
story_structure.resolution: Malee comes to terms with the truth of her past, allowing her to process her long-standing burden and move forward with clarity alongside Pran as a new chapter begins.
story_structure.introduction: Malee, a young woman carrying the weight of a troubled past, is drawn to a specific apartment where unresolved childhood memories begin to resurface. There, she crosses paths with Pran, a botanist and tea blending master who runs a Thai floral tea brand.
story_structure.risingAction: Malee spends more time around Pran and his crafts, uncovering layered secrets behind both the location and her past. With every revelation, her traumatic childhood experiences demand recognition, forcing her to navigate escalating tension between fear of her past and a growing bond with Pran.
